name: @jeswr/solid-wallet
description: Generated document vault model, expiry helpers and private pod repository for Wallet.
author: Jesse Wright

scripts.build: pnpm -w exec tsc -p packages/solid-wallet/tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs
scripts.codegen: node node_modules/@jeswr/federation-codegen/dist/cli.js gen --ontology codegen/wallet.ttl --shapes codegen/wallet.shacl.ttl --config codegen.config.json --out src/generated
scripts.lint: pnpm -w exec biome check packages/solid-wallet/src packages/solid-wallet/scripts packages/solid-wallet/test packages/solid-wallet/codegen.config.json packages/solid-wallet/package.json packages/solid-wallet/vitest.config.ts
